AP-NORC Oct 8–12; Economist/YouGov Oct 10–12 (closed list); Pew Sep 28 – Oct 4, registered voters. Dashes mean the poll did not ask that item. Sources: AP-NORC, Economist/YouGov, Pew.

Fraud

“Fraud” shows up in three different ways this cycle, and none ranks as a top issue in the major issue polls. Government-benefits fraud, centered on Minnesota's program scandals, is the most prominent: in a June KFF poll, 55% of Republican voters called fraud in health programs extremely important for candidates to discuss, and in September voters split almost evenly on which party they trust to handle it (29% Democrats, 31% Republicans). Election fraud: 13% name it as a worry about November (Economist/YouGov). Polling fraud: Wedgewood Polls admitted fabricating its data on October 20; its polls are excluded here.

Sources: KFF, PBS NewsHour.
